subject: DPA evidence staging & DPIA handoff — audit access playbook
messages:
From: Lena Hsu <lena.hsu@tailwindhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@tailwindhealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: DPA / DPIA evidence request + access window

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick DPA draft last week. To close our internal review we need a short runbook for handover of DPIA-related evidence and confirmation of audit access for the next 30 days. Specifically our privacy team has requested the following items before we finalise the procurement: 

- Article 28 & 30 artifacts: processing map excerpt, subprocessors list (current snapshot), and the most recent Article 30 register export
- DPIA evidence pack: KMS attestation excerpt, retention/erase workflows, and sampling of processing logs (past 90 days)
- Operational access plan: who to contact for an audit, temporary read-only SSO accounts, and a proposed 48–72 hour evidence handover window

Can you confirm Redwood can provide a staging bundle (preferably a Drive folder link) and a nominated ops contact? We’re trying to schedule the handover the week of Dec 14 and want to include legal/contracts for any DPA amendment signatures.

Appreciate a brief plan and a list of attachments you’ll deliver.

Best,
Lena Hsu
Privacy Lead, Tailwind Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hsu <lena.hsu@tailwindhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, contracts@tailwindhealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA / DPIA evidence request + access window

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can support the request and propose the following lightweight staging and handoff plan so you can share with privacy/legal: 

1) Evidence bundle (delivered to a read-only shared Drive folder):
   - redwood_dpia_evidence_checklist.xlsx (artifact map + pointers)
   - access_inventory_snapshot.csv (current subprocessors + roles)
   - article30_register_export.json (exported ledger excerpt)
   - sampling: processing_logs_sample.tar.gz (redacted traces; token-level removed)

2) Access and ops contact: 
   - Primary: Marissa Cole (Security Operations) — marissa.cole@redwood.com
   - Secondary: Jonas Weber (Privacy Engineering) — jonas.weber@redwood.com

3) Proposed timeline:
   - Week of Dec 14: create Drive folder and upload initial bundle (read-only link)
   - Dec 15: 2-hour walkthrough session (ops + privacy) and temporary SSO read-only accounts activated for the 72-hour window
   - Dec 18–21: follow-up Q&A and any supplemental extracts

4) DPA amendment / signatures: if Tailwind requires a short amendment for audit access we can generate a DocuSign envelope once contracts confirm the scope.

I’ve attached the DPIA checklist and an SSO onboarding template for your legal/privacy team to preview. Marissa — can you confirm the availability of the processing log sample and a sandbox S3 location for the bundle? Jonas — please confirm KMS export cadence and whether we need a separate KMS attestation PDF.

Thanks — Priyom
Head of Privacy Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lena Hsu <lena.hsu@tailwindhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA / DPIA evidence request + access window

Hi all — quick ops update and confirmations: 

- Processing log sample: I can produce a 90-day redacted sample (CSV bundle) and will place it in a temporary staging S3 bucket with a pre-signed read-only link. Filename: access_inventory_snapshot.csv and processing_logs_sample_90d.tar.gz (both attached as stubs in the plan).
- KMS attestation: Jonas, can you export the attestation PDF as discussed? If not, I’ll work with infra to pull the KMS key metadata and we’ll generate a vetted excerpt.
- Temporary accounts: we can create two read-only SSO accounts scoped to the evidence folder and logs; these will be active for a 72-hour window. Ops will require a formal ticket with Tailwind: please include the desired user emails and the requested time-window (UTC).

Operational checklist attached: sso_onboarding_template.docx — includes required fields for the ticket.

Next steps (owner):
- Tailwind: confirm the exact day/time during week of Dec 14 and provide attendee emails (Lena / contracts) — ACTION: Tailwind
- Marissa: prepare staging bucket and upload initial bundle by Dec 14 — ACTION: Marissa
- Jonas: confirm KMS attestation export by Dec 10 — ACTION: Jonas

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA / DPIA evidence request + access window

Thanks Priyom and Marissa — this plan looks good to us. A few confirmations from Tailwind: 

- We’ll take the 2-hour walkthrough on Dec 15 at 10:30 AM PT (please send calendar invite). Attendees: Lena Hsu (privacy), contracts@tailwindhealth.com, and our external counsel (cc'd on the invite).
- For the temporary SSO accounts please allow access from 10:30 AM PT on Dec 15 through 10:30 AM PT on Dec 18 (72 hours) and set account names to the pattern tailwind_audit_{name}@tailwindhealth.com.
- Contracts: please prepare a short DPA addendum (DocuSign) that authorises temporary audit access and confirms the evidence retention/cleanup window. If you can send a draft by EOD Dec 14 that would be ideal.

Once we have the Drive link and pre-signed S3 URLs we will confirm receipt and begin the walkthrough. 

Appreciate the clear owners and timeline — see you on Dec 15.

Lena Hsu
Privacy Lead, Tailwind Health
